about: #3391: core-backend's own answers for each kind of fixed_in_dispute, dumped from its matcher (core-backend/internal/cve at #3391, by a test run through go test -overlay that serves each fixture of pkgmatch_fixedin_cna_test.go through registryTestApp and decodeJSON(matchPath(...)), re-taken 2026-11-01 during its fifth round, with nothing written to its worktree), so the relay is held to the shapes the API sends, not to synthetic ones. match: GET /api/v1/public/cves/match's answer, whole. remediation: the installed-version fields of GET .../cves/:id/remediation (installedFixFromRows, as remediation.go sets fixed_in, fixed_in_reason, fixed_in_detail and fixed_in_dispute beside installed). The cases: higher cna or advisory; kind fixed or introduced; the advisory's bound as advisory_fixed, advisory_last_affected, advisory_introduced (on either kind) or a version it lists (advisory_listed); the CNA's range ending at less_than or less_than_or_equal, with changes, or a span its defaultStatus implies (cna_range_default); a CNA that states no status past its range (cna_states_no_status: fixed_in is that range's bound, the advisory's fix being lower), and one whose range names no end (cna_affected_no_end: fixed_in null, with fixed_in_reason); a version the CNA lists by itself, which raises the match with no dispute (cna_listed_alone_no_dispute: version_evidence cna_affected_range, fixed_in null), and an advisory interval's match whose fix the CNA lists as affected, no dispute either (advisory_interval_cna_listed_at_fix: fixed_in null); and a version the CVE record's CNA states no end for, beside the advisory's fix below it, answered undetermined (cna_range_open_ended: qs 6.14.1 under CVE-2025-15284, re-taken 2026-11-07 from 95927abe, the commit that ships #3391), with no match. Round 11: a remediation answer carries no fixed_in_dispute where there is none, and installed carries the ecosystem the handler sets, as 95927abe's wire does.
